notes.title: Blue Fish Yokohoma - Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Blue Fish Yokohama - Patch 1.1 [/b][/h3]

First update to the game :)

Changes:
[list]
[*] It's now possible to unlock levels in numerical sequence
[*] Update to level 3
[*] Changed initial song
[*] Added blue fish icon to the .exe
[*] Bug fixes 
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blue Fish Yokohama is out!!!
notes.notes:
Today marks an important day for us! Blue Fish Yokohama, our very first puzzle game, is being publicly released on Steam! Feel free to check it out and leave us your comments at Twitter @fish_slippy or via email with slippyfishstudio@gmail.com

[previewyoutube=aujRjRD2lLk;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your support of indie gaming. Lots of love and wishing you bowls of tasty ramen in your future!

notes.title: Playing Blue Fish Yokohama during Steam NextFest
notes.notes:
Blue Fish Yokohama is a tile-based puzzle game for ramen lovers.

We are very excited to show the world our debut game! We will talk about the origins and backstory of the game, the development process, we will play and showcase the various mechanics and levels in the game. Feel free to ask us any questions. Drop by and say hi!
